photos.file: Urtica dioica - Stinging Nettle on way from Gangria to Valley of Flowers National Park - during LGFC - VOF 2019 (15).jpg
photos.desc: Photos from Valley of Flowers trip during LGFC - VOF 2019
Morning in the Irpin river floodplain. Former collective farm fields, now overgrown with Urtica dioica . Near Nyvka river mouth, Kiev-Svyatoshyn raion, Kiev oblast, Ukraine
Nom français : grande ortie. Nom anglais : stinging nettle. Tige de grande ortie.
